verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, an explicit toolkit letting AI agents act on the account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building reports) plus developer connectors that plug AI coding agents into docs/sandbox, and a CLI for command-line operation — all pointing toward natural-language/agent-driven operation. However, evidence doesn't confirm a conversational/natural-language interface for end users themselves (vs. developers wiring up agents), and no independent/hands-on corroboration exists. Missing for 10: end-user natural-language interface evidence, independent hands-on validation of AgentOS in practice.
